title: Firmwares
description: Firmwares - set up the XPRS station you just flashed: claim it, put it on your WiFi, name it, and read how it is doing.
summary: A freshly flashed XPRS station asks, over Bluetooth, to be claimed. This app notices it, tells you, and sets it up from your phone: it becomes yours, joins your WiFi with the password sealed to its key so nobody nearby can read it, takes a name and a time zone, keeps or changes its identity, and reports its firmware, uptime and memory. Boards without Bluetooth are set up the same way from their own WiFi hotspot.
